content: Root cause: The bug was caused by a use-after-free condition in the virtual memory area (VMA) fault handling, where the buffer object (BO) could be freed after the `mmap_sem` semaphore was released. This allowed other tasks to destroy the VMA, leading to potential access of a freed BO, which was indicated by a lock debugging warning related to the mutex being locked while the BO was being destroyed. The patch addresses this by ensuring that a reference to the BO is held until it is no longer needed, preventing it from being freed prematurely.
